content:
Canva today released Canva Code 2.0, an AI-powered vibe coding platform that allows users to build and visually edit websites, apps, and interactive experiences. Details below.

"Build websites, apps, and interactive experiences with vibe coding, then edit them like Canva designs"

A few months ago, Canva announced the launch of Canva AI 2.0, a unified conversational interface covering design, automation, and content creation, built on the company's proprietary Proteus, Lucid Origin, and I2V generative image and video models.

Today, the company further expanded its AI-powered coding tools, announcing Canva Code 2.0, which promises to make it easier to "design engaging, easy-to-build interactive experiences that align with your brand identity" through "new features that combine creative autonomy with the latest AI coding models".

Canva Code 2.0 allows users to start from prompts, choose from more than 50 new templates, or import HTML to continue editing pages built with other AI platforms or assistants. It also supports real-time collaboration among team members.

It can also seamlessly integrate with other Canva tools, giving users greater creative autonomy and making it easier to keep projects consistent with the brand identity.

Canva says:

When it's time to publish, Canva Code 2.0 allows users to connect a custom domain, or publish to a free Canva domain. The company says the output is fully interactive, automatically adapts to different screen sizes, and can be previewed on a mobile device before going live.
